page.overview:
Who is Barr?

Barr, designated as CT-41/14-0301, was a clone trooper lieutenant in the Grand Army of the Republic who fought in the Clone Wars. Barr was the leader of the 2nd Platoon of the 327th Star Corps's Bacta Company. The platoon had four squads under Barr's command—a total of thirty-two men and four medics.

Born on the planet Kamino from the genetic template of bounty hunter Jango Fett,

Early in the war, the 327th, led by Clone Commander Bly, attempted to reap information from the memory banks of a Confederate tactical droid, by setting up a trap in a rocky canyon. They were able to fabricate an information bunker, which attracted the attention of the tactical droid. In turn, the droid ordered his troops to attack the bunker, prompting Barr and the men of the 327th to attack them from the rear. They charged in on jetpacks and began firing, with Commander Bly ordering Barr and Galle to take out the super battle droids. They were able to effectively dispatch the tactical droid's troops, while Jedi General Aayla Secura beheaded the tactical droid. Since the droid had not gone into cyberostasis, they would be able to plunder its memory banks for intel.

As the war continued, Barr was eventually promoted to the rank of lieutenant. As a Clone Lieutenant, Barr led the 327th's 2nd Platoon, which comprised of thirty-two clone troopers and four clone medics divided into four squads.
